name: xuan-gu-mo-fang
description: Provides millisecond-level market snapshot data for Shanghai and Shenzhen indices, stocks, funds and other instruments, supports all-dimensional sector rankings by industry and concept, and ships featured stock pools plus in-depth data such as F10, market temperature, volume forecast and advance/decline distribution.

display.name: 选股魔方
display.description_zh: 提供沪深指数、股票、基金等品种毫秒级行情快照数据，支持行业、概念等全维板块排行，内置黄金杯、三步点金等特色股池，并附F10资料、市场温度、量能预测、涨跌分布等深度数据，一站式支撑A股研究与选股决策。
display.description_en: Provides millisecond-level market snapshot data for Shanghai and Shenzhen indices, stocks, funds and other instruments, supports all-dimensional sector rankings by industry and concept, and ships featured stock pools plus in-depth data such as F10, market temperature, volume forecast and advance/decline distribution.
